capabilities: Syncs vault files to a self-hosted Courier server
Encrypts note contents and paths on the device
Keeps per-file version history with restore and recycle bin
Parks conflicting files for one-click compare and replace
Filters which file types and folders sync per device
extras: README is a generated build artifact; source and docs live at courier.dev. Losing the vault password makes remote content undecryptable — there is no reset. No telemetry; the server operator sees only vault sizes, version timestamps and device labels.
problem: Obsidian offers no self-hosted, on-device-encrypted way to keep a vault consistent across devices without a third-party cloud.
summary: Self-hosted sync client that encrypts an Obsidian vault on the device and syncs it across devices to a server you run.
